newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. threatens to take "suitable action" against Iraq's decision to send helicopters to bring back Iraqi pilrgrims from Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company's net profit in the first three months of 1997 were $39 million.
- Tunisia's exports increased 14 percent in the first quarter of 1997 to $1.4 billion.
- Egypt is to try on Thursday an Israeli accused of spying for Israel.
- Israel's higher court received five appeals demanding indictment against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
- Saudi Arabia's health insurance scheme is expected to generate around 4.5 billion riyals when implemented.
